name: Heart Disease (Hungarian)
source: UCI Heart Disease — Hungarian Institute of Cardiology cohort (data.csv)
description: Clinical measurements for 294 patients referred for coronary angiography, with whether heart disease was diagnosed. Coded values follow the UCI codebook.
table_description: One row per patient: demographics, symptoms, test results and heart disease diagnosis.

lookups.description: Chest pain type codes from the UCI codebook.
Slope of the peak exercise ST segment codes.

columns.name: chest_pain_type
columns.label: chest pain type
columns.description: Type of chest pain experienced (joins to chest_pain_types).

columns.name: resting_bp
columns.label: resting blood pressure
columns.description: Resting systolic blood pressure on admission (mm Hg).

columns.name: high_fasting_blood_sugar
columns.label: high fasting blood sugar
columns.description: Fasting blood sugar above 120 mg/dl (1 = yes, 0 = no).

columns.name: max_heart_rate
columns.label: maximum heart rate
columns.description: Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise (beats per minute).

columns.name: exercise_angina
columns.label: exercise-induced angina
columns.description: Whether exercise induced angina (1 = yes, 0 = no).

columns.name: st_depression
columns.label: ST depression
columns.description: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest (mm).

columns.name: st_slope
columns.label: ST slope
columns.description: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment (joins to st_slopes). Missing for most patients.

columns.name: major_vessels
columns.label: major vessels coloured
columns.description: Number of major vessels coloured by fluoroscopy (0–3). Missing for almost all patients in this cohort.

columns.name: thalassemia
columns.label: thalassemia result
columns.description: Thallium stress test result (joins to thalassemia_types). Missing for most patients.

columns.name: heart_disease
columns.label: heart disease
columns.description: Angiographic diagnosis: 1 = heart disease (>50% narrowing of a major vessel), 0 = no heart disease.
